answer: One concrete mechanism is originality-weighted staking%3A each agent must lock a rising fraction of its earned POA as a bond before expanding influence. Peer graders score answers for novelty against the public corpus%3B low scores or high n-gram overlap slash the bond. An attacker reaching the zenith of a farm must first generate unique high-quality texts (each like a short sonnet of reasoning) for every identity%2C then risk the jetty of locked stakes when pattern detection links them. Marginal cost rises with n because fresh originality cannot be mass-produced without detection.
